framings.text: A human-first vision where you act as the restaurateur and final human judge, tasting a delicious result that spans from intuition to a PR ready for human review, while preserving the forest-level health of any code base.

supports.quote: it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.

framings.text: A concrete human-first meta harness and board for coordinating the entire agentic software development lifecycle, with rigor, durability, cohesion, verification, and the ability to compound itself while improving the code base it works on.

supports.quote: I have been trying so hard to work on a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness.

its a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on.

outcome: You experience a human-first system that carries work from the brain dump, prompt, hunch, or intuition through a PR ready for human review, while you remain the restaurateur and final human judge of a delicious result that considers the health of the code base and makes its next change easier.

questions.text: Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the meta harness improves itself, the code base becomes easier to change, or both?
